armGroups.label: AIN457 300 mg
armGroups.description: patients received AIN457 (secukinumab) 300 mg (two secukinumab 150 mg injections) s.c. (subcutaneously) once every week at weeks 0, 1,2,3, followed by monthly dosing starting at week 4 to week 48 inclusive

armGroups.label: Ustekinumab
armGroups.description: patients received ustekinumab 45/90 mg (weight depended, according to label) s.c. (subcutaneously) and/or placebo secukinumab injections once every week at weeks 0,1,2, and 3 followed by monthly dosing starting at week 4 to week 48 inclusive

participantFlowModule.recruitmentDetails: Of the 676 patients who were randomized to the study, 571 patients completed the study (286 patients (84.9%) in the secukinumab group and 285 patients (84.1%) in the ustekinumab group. Efficacy Data up to 52 weeks and Safety Data included up to 104 weeks
